plan_output_unit_reparameterization.note: Inverse scale of final Linear rows; Adam parameterization changes, not target coordinates

checkpoint_manifest.metric: mean of cumulative ADE@1/2/3s; no sample proxy

bn_training.inference_policy: eval running statistics for both arms

checkpoint_manifest.sample_order_policy: dedicated torch generator(seed); row+epoch deterministic photometric jitter; rolling row SHA per log

protocol.donor_policy: full tune split Sattolo scene permutation; same frame; image tensors only

bucket_definition.source: GT state_target only; never model-predicted state
bucket_definition.accel: not stop; valid ego-x acceleration ax >= 0.5 m/s^2
bucket_definition.decel: not stop; valid ego-x acceleration ax <= -0.5 m/s^2
bucket_definition.cruise: not stop; valid ego-x acceleration -0.5 < ax < 0.5 m/s^2
bucket_definition.priority: stop first; mutually exclusive and exhaustive
bucket_definition.axes: current ego x=longitudinal, y=lateral; not a trajectory-tangent frame

time_input_policy.scope: model input time_offsets only; identical policy for every condition

protocol.target_time_semantics: Official cached frame-offset targets preserved; actual raw timestamps can differ from nominal 0.5-second spacing
protocol.metric: mean cumulative ADE@1/2/3s; [11,11,5,5,2,2]/36; equal frame weights
protocol.coordinate_format: current ego-frame cumulative XY positions, metres; no cumsum or postprocessing
caveats: Image counterfactuals break image/geometry consistency and are diagnostics, not automatic compliance proof.
Repeatedly used tune is not an untouched holdout; this evaluator performs no checkpoint/condition selection.
